jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Founding Product Manager to join one of our clients ' team. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
 
 Berlin • Cybersecurity & AI Startup • Recently Funded 
 A newly funded cybersecurity startup in Berlin is looking for a Founding Product Manager to join as a founding team member and help design the core security, identity, and enforcement foundations of a next-generation AI-powered security risk management platform. 
 It’s an early-stage startup founded by experienced cybersecurity leaders with backgrounds in Israeli Intelligence units. We are looking for a hands-on Founding Product Manager for a hybrid role based in central of Berlin. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and AI tech, thrive in fast-paced startup environments, and enjoy building complex platforms from the ground up, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. 
 They’re building a next-generation cyber risk platform that helps enterprises understand, measure, and reduce identity risk at scale. Our goal is to turn complex identity and security data into clear, actionable risk insights that CISOs and CTOs can trust. You will work from scratch on core platform components from day one, shaping how modern enterprises manage and reason about risk using cloud-native systems and AI-driven analysis and automated enforcement through AI Agents. 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Define and build product for new cyber security product from scratch 

 Design end-to-end user journeys across the entire platform, from onboarding to daily usage and advanced workflows 

 Define platform information architecture, navigation, and core UX principles 

 Own wireframes, user flows , and interaction logic (from low-fidelity to production-ready concepts) 

 Prepare tickets and own backlog 

 Translate user needs, risk scenarios, and business goals into intuitive UI/UX decisions 

 Contribute the product vision and translate it into a clear, actionable roadmap 

 Ensure complex security and risk concepts are expressed in simple, usable interfaces 

 Drive product discovery , validation, and prioritization from day zero 

 Work closely with engineering, security, and data teams to ship the right product fast 

 Define MVP scope, iterate based on real customer feedback, and avoid over-engineering 

 Balance security, usability, and scalability in a complex cyber risk platform 

 Represent the product internally and externally with customers, partners, and investors 

 Build whole platform from scratch 

 
 
 Must have skills: 
 10+ years of hands-on experience designing complex B2B SaaS web platforms for technical products 

 Proven ability to scatch end-to-end user journeys using Figma (flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes) 

 Strong experience with design systems and component-based UX (Figma libraries, tokens, variants) 

 Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Notion, Confluence, or similar 

 Experience working closely with engineering teams using Jira, Linear, or GitHub Projects 

 Solid understanding of REST APIs of SaaS integrations and backend-driven UIs (can read OpenAPI / Swagger specs) 

 Experience defining data-heavy dashboards (tables, filters, charts, drill-downs) 

 Strong grasp of UX for complex domains (security, risk, finance, compliance, or enterprise admin tools) 

 Familiarity with event tracking and product analytics

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles, delivering an ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform alongside a manufacturing architecture that scales from large to extra-large vehicle sizes. The Dive-XL programme is designed, built and tested in Australia and is executing against live contracts. The XL Vehicle System team owns the vehicle end to end – systems, software, mechanical, electrical, and integration and test.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own programme execution across the XL vehicle system as it moves from development into production, reporting to the Director of Platforms. The role requires both programme management rigour and genuine technical depth: you will be expected to engage substantively on system architecture, interfaces and verification approach alongside the engineering discipline leads.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own programme planning end to end for the vehicle system: scoping, sequencing, dependency mapping, risk identification, and driving decisions when requirements, timelines or resourcing conflict. 
  • Stand up and run the scaled agile cadence across the vehicle programme — coordinating planning increments, cross-team dependency mapping, and integration points across up to ~100 engineers spanning multiple agile teams. Own the rhythm: PI planning, backlog alignment, system demos and inspect-and-adapt events, ensuring the cadence actually drives decisions rather than just generating ceremony. 
  • Implement and maintain robust project management methodologies and best practices across the programme, driving predictability and accountability. 
  • Proactively identify and mitigate programme risks and challenges, developing mitigation plans alongside the engineers who will execute them. 
  • Engage with the technical substance of the programme – architecture, requirements baselines, interfaces and verification approach – well enough to catch problems early rather than simply track status. 
  • Partner with discipline leads as a technical peer, pressure-testing estimates and identifying missing scope before a schedule or resourcing decision is made. 
  • Translate system-level requirements and subsystem dependencies into a sequenced plan that reflects how the vehicle is actually integrated and tested.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Neobank
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Steuerung digitaler Produkte und Plattformen. 
 Kenntnisse in nutzerzentrierter Produktentwicklung und ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Nutzerführung. 
 Erfahrung im Umgang mit Content-Management-Systemen. 
 Eine strukturierte, analytische und gleichzeitig nutzerorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Kenntnisse in Inoloft sind von Vorteil. 
 Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und an der Koordination von Schnittstellen.

jobs.title: (Senior) Project Manager Post Merger Integration [m/w/d]
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind Die GBC Group GmbH ist eine inhabergeführte IT-Unternehmensgruppe mit über 500 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 10 Standorten in Deutschland. Nach dem Buy-and-Build-Prinzip vereinen wir 12 spezialisierte Tochtergesellschaften unter einem Dach, jede mit eigener Expertise und einer gemeinsamen Vision. Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.

 Dein Wirkungsfeld Wenn die GBC Group eine Gesellschaft übernimmt, beginnt die eigentliche Arbeit erst danach: Strukturen zusammenführen, Standards etablieren, Führung, Ergebnisse sichtbar machen. Genau hier setzt diese Rolle an. Du bist die Verbindung zwischen der strategischen Agenda der Gruppe und der operativen Realität in den Tochtergesellschaften und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Zielen tatsächlich Ergebnisse werden.

Du agierst dabei nicht als Berater, der Empfehlungen abgibt und wieder geht, sondern als jemand, der mit den Geschäftsführern vor Ort Umsetzungen schafft, Widerstände einkalkuliert und trotzdem liefert. Dein Beitrag entscheidet mit darüber, wie schnell und wie erfolgreich eine Integration gelingt.

 Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung Du übersetzt strategische Ziele der Gruppe in konkrete, messbare Projekte gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften vor Ort
 Du analysierst, definierst und planst Verbesserungsinitiativen aus,- etwa zur Steigerung der operativen Auslastung, zum Aufbau von Führungs- und Reportingstrukturen, zur Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung oder zur Einführung von IT-Systemen und trackst deren Umsetzung konsequent bis zum Abschluss
 Du gestaltest die projektbegleitende Kommunikation aktiv und steuerst Stakeholder proaktiv, statt auf Widerstände zu reagieren
 Du sparrst und coachst Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe - auch wenn das bedeutet, unbequeme Punkte anzusprechen
 Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der GBC Group Geschäftsführung PMI-Blueprints und Standards, die für künftige Integrationen wiederverwendbar sind
 Du reportest transparent an die GBC Group Führung und eskalierst Risiken frühzeitig
 

 Was Du mitbringst Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Zahlenaffinität
 Beratungshintergrund aus der Prozess-, Strategie- oder IT-Beratung
 Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit, Führungserfahrung
 Projektleitungserfahrung in komplexen Change- und Implementierungsprojekten 
 Erfahrung in Post-Merger-Integration-Projekten, Operational Excellence
 Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit klarem Fokus auf das Wesentliche
 Affinität zu Informationstechnologie, insbesondere zu KI-Systemen
 Reisebereitschaft sowie einen Führerschein Klasse B
 Kann-Kriterien
 Expertenwissen in M365, vor allem PowerPoint, Excel und Power BI
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar
 

 Was Dich bei uns erwartet Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und entsprechend wenig Kontrolle im Detail - wir erwarten, dass du Ergebnisse lieferst, nicht dass du Beschäftigung nachweist
 Deine Entwicklung bei uns hängt an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Titeln oder Betriebszugehörigkeit
 Reporting und Entscheidungswege sind kurz und direkt, auch zur Geschäftsführung
 Bis zu 20 % deiner Arbeitszeit kannst du remote gestalten, der überwiegende Teil findet dort statt, wo die Projekte laufen - bei den Tochtergesellschaften in Norddeutschland
 Leistungsorientierte Kultur: Entwicklung, Förderung und Wertschätzung erfolgen basierend auf tatsächlicher Leistung

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Platform Experiences
jobs.description:
Your mission Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Matrix42's platform experiences — the foundation that powers every Matrix42 product across Service management, Asset management, Endpoint management, and more. This is a high-ownership role that shapes how admins configure, developers extend, and end users interact with the platform, and how AI agents operate inside it.
  

 Your profile What you'll do 
 Own the platform toolkit end-to-end: dashboards, reports, layouts, components, service desk experiences, and the workflow designer that powers connected workflows across products
 Sharpen the connected workflows concept — how workflows span multiple products, systems, and personas, and how they compose into reusable, packaged solutions
 Drive the extensibility model: APIs, integrations, and how partners and customers extend the platform to fit their environment
 Shape AI as an active layer in the platform — agentic workflows that configure, orchestrate, and reason across the environment, not just assist users at the edges
 Serve three distinct personas well: End users consuming self-service experiences and interacting with services
 Admins and configurators building workflows, dashboards, and services without specialist support
 Developers and builders extending the platform through APIs, integrations, and custom logic
 
 Enable the platform to power all Matrix42 product lines with a coherent, opinionated experience
 Partner with product experience, engineering, and adjacent product teams that consume the platform
 Define success metrics around adoption, configurability, time-to-value, and platform stickiness across all persona layers
 Engage directly with enterprise customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to shape the roadmap
 What we're looking for 
 Product management experience in enterprise SaaS, ideally on a platform or horizontal capability team
 Track record designing for multiple personas — end user, admin, and developer — as distinct users with distinct needs
 Strong understanding of configurable platforms, low-code/no-code patterns, workflow designers, and component-based product design
 Experience with platform extensibility: APIs, integrations, and third-party ecosystems
 Practical exposure to agentic AI or AI-driven workflow orchestration — how AI agents can operate inside a platform, not just alongside it
 UX-oriented mindset with a track record of close collaboration with design
 Ability to communicate across C-level, sales, and engineering stakeholders
 Comfort balancing needs of multiple internal product teams and external customers
 

 Why us? By using our platform, customers can manage IT and business processes, assets, endpoints, and identities for improved productivity, agility, security, and employee experience. By enabling digital working environments and IT self-service through holistic integration and automated processes, we digitalize and automate our customers’ everyday tasks. Join our diverse team of 600 professionals spread across Europe. Our culture is built on strong values, with customer success as our top priority. We support your personal and professional growth, helping you reach your full potential through personalized goals. Join us on a journey where you can thrive in both your career and personal life. 

 Our Benefits We could start by mentioning the fundamentals – 30 vacation days, flexible self-managed working hours, and a hybrid setup that supports remote work. But what truly sets this role apart is the opportunity to be part of a distinct European growth journey – shaping the European choice in Service Management that is a trusted and loved player in the market, while contributing to a company that is scaling with clear purpose, ambition, and customer focus. 

 Your contact person Send us your application  IN ENGLISH , including your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, directly through our online portal via the  "APPLY NOW"  button. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact  Yuliia Borodatova .  

We would like to inform you that MATRIX42 can only accept applications online via the applicant portal in connection with our applicant management system because of the currently valid EU data protection regulations. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all genders and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner – CRM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:

You combine product ownership with a strong focus on business process excellence, challenging existing ways of working and identifying opportunities for simplification and automation. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you align stakeholders across functions and countries around a shared product vision. Through continuous improvement of customer, operational, and financial processes, you help create better customer experiences, higher efficiency, and scalable business operations.

 Menu of Responsibilities In this role, you take ownership of our CRM and ERP landscape and drive continuous improvement across business-critical processes: 
 Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Odoo-based CRM and ERP platforms, aligned with business strategy and customer experience goals. 
 Analyse , challenge, and continuously improve end-to-end business processes across Order-to-Cash, billing, payments, customer management,  logistics , procurement, and finance. 
 Own and  prioritise  the product backlog, translating business needs and process improvement opportunities into clear user stories and deliverables. 
 Partner with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Support, Operations, Logistics, and Data teams to align priorities and  maximise  business value. 
 Lead collaboration with implementation and service partners, ensuring solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and expected outcomes. 
 Drive adoption of new capabilities by ensuring process integrity, data quality, effective release planning, stakeholder engagement, and continuous feedback. 
 

 Ingredients for Success Proven  experience  in  Product  Ownership,  Product  Management, Business Analysis,  or  a  similar   role   within  CRM, ERP,  or   business   systems   environments . 
 Strong  understanding  of  commercial , operational,  financial , and  logistics   processes ,  with  the  ability  to  identify  and  drive   process   improvements . 
 Experience  managing   product   backlogs ,  priorities , and  stakeholder   expectations   within  agile  ways  of  working . 
 Excellent  communication  and  facilitation   skills ,  enabling   alignment  and  decision-making   across  diverse  stakeholder   groups . 
 Customer- focused   mindset   combined   with  a  passion  for  continuous   improvement , operational excellence, and  measurable   business   outcomes . 
 Experience working with CRM and ERP platforms; knowledge of Odoo is beneficial. Fluent English is  required .

jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum Wir? Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

 Das erwartet Dich Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören: Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
 Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
 Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
 Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
 Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
 Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
 Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.
 

 Das bringst Du mit Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
 Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
 Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
 Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
 Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
 Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
 Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
 Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
 Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
 Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
 

 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.  Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen: Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
 Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
 Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen).
 Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich.
 Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank. 
 Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Events für Mitarbeitende - virtuell oder vor Ort sorgen für Zusammenhalt.
 Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement: DocuWare steht für papierloses Arbeiten und unterstützt ehrenamtliche Organisationen und lokale Sportvereine.
 Gute Erreichbarkeit auf allen Wegen: Komm ins Büro mit dem geleasten E-Bike (Jobrad), per S-Bahn oder über die Autobahnen A96/A99 (Dein E-Auto kannst Du vor Ort kostenlos laden).
 Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
 Ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen erhältst Du eine unbefristete Festanstellung.
 Wir nutzen immer die neuesten Technologien: Erfahre mehr auf Stackshare.
 Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Senior Project Manager experienced managing technical teams and releases across complex client environments required to join our Team!

The opportunity

You'll encourage strong relationships with your team and have the ability to talk, at a technical level, with developers and senior technical team members (e.g., technical architects, solution architects etc). You will follow best practices in development standards and coding reviews through having a good understanding of branching strategies, development standards and coding reviews through having a good understanding of branching strategies, development principals and CI/CD.

What you’ll be doing

  • Release and technical reporting regarding project/account technical deliverables, architecture and release pipeline
  • Management of project plans and detailed reporting to ensure efficient tracking of the project
  • RAID log management and escalation for the project
  • Identify technical risks and issues & provide mitigation options to achieve resolution
  • Knowledgeably communicate with stakeholders (internal/external) including chairing technical meetings as required
  • Manage and co-ordinate Internal technical specialists
  • Lead and inspire the team to achieve individual and team objectives
  • Ensure the technical team(s) complete what is expected of them successfully and suggest improvements to processes as required.
  • Define, plan, organise and manage the build of new infrastructure environments
  • Co-ordinate high quality technical solutions, on time, via effective time management

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

About The Role

We are seeking a visionary and results-oriented Senior Product Leader to lead Verifone's product strategy and execution across key business lines. This role will oversee the full product lifecycle, from ideation and market analysis to launch and ongoing optimization. The Senior Director will partner closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and operations to deliver innovative solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth. 

This is a high-impact leadership role requiring deep product expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, global environment. The ideal candidate brings broad knowledge across the complete payments solution stack and a proven track record of delivering complex, enterprise-scale initiatives across EMEA markets. 

Key Responsibilities 

Product Strategy & Leadership 

  • Develop and execute product strategy aligned with Verifone's vision and business objectives. 
  • Lead portfolio management across multiple product lines, ensuring market relevance and profitability. 
  • Define product roadmaps and prioritize initiatives based on customer needs, market trends, and business goals. 
  • Apply deep knowledge across the complete solution stack — including hardware/payment devices, payment applications, gateways, acquiring processing, and acquiring services — to inform strategic product direction. 

Market & Customer Focus 

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats across EMEA and global markets. 
  • Champion the voice of the customer by integrating feedback into product development.

 auf jede Frage eine schnelle Buzzword-Antwort parat hast,

 Messbarkeit und Wirkung dich kaltlassen.

jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

About Ema 
 Ema is building the world’s leading Agentic AI platform to transform enterprise productivity. We enable organizations to delegate repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI Employee, delivering 10x gains in workforce efficiency, across functions. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production — we ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
 Opportunity Summary: 
 Ema is building the next generation AI technology to empower every employee in the enterprise to be their most creative and productive. Our proprietary tech allows enterprises to delegate most repetitive tasks to Ema, the Universal AI employee. We are founded by ex-Google, Coinbase, Okta executives, and serial entrepreneurs. We’re well-funded by the top investors and angels in the world. Ema is based in Silicon Valley with offices in Bangalore. This will be a hybrid role where we expect employees to work from the office three days a week.
 
 In this role, your work will involve:  
 Product Strategy & Vision: 
 Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap based on market trends, customer needs, and company goals.

 Work closely with senior management and stakeholders to align the product strategy with business objectives.

 Market & User Research: 
 Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities, gaps, and market demands.

 Understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements.

 Define user personas and use cases to ensure products meet user expectations.

 Product Development: 
 Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver products that are functional, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.

 Prioritize product features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer feedback, technical feasibility, and business impact.

 Manage the product development lifecycle, including setting timelines and milestones.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: 
 Work closely with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, customer support) to ensure successful product launches.

 Communicate progress, roadblocks, and product updates with stakeholders and teams across the organization.

 Lead and facilitate communication between technical and non-technical teams.

 Performance Tracking & Iteration: 
 Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success.

 Track product performance post-launch and gather customer feedback for continuous improvement.

 Iterate on product features based on data insights and feedback.

 Stakeholder Management: 
 Present product updates, roadmaps, and strategies to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

 Manage relationships with external vendors and partners as needed.

 Go-to-Market Strategy: 
 Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to define go-to-market strategies for product launches.

 Ensure proper communication and training for internal teams and customers during product releases.

 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

 3-5 years of experience in product management, preferably in the tech or software industry.

 Strong understanding of product development processes, including agile methodologies.

 Ability to work with cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.

 Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

 Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.

 Strong organizational and project management skills.

 Preferred Skills: 
 Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Asana, or other project management platforms.

 Knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles.

 Experience working with APIs and technical teams.

 Data-driven mindset with experience in A/B testing and user research methodologies.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Identity for AI
jobs.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the evolution of Ping Identity’s Identity for AI solution: a strategic product initiative focused on securing and enabling Agentic AI. In this high-impact role, you’ll help define how AI agents securely access resources and shape the capabilities that will be foundational to Ping’s platform in the AI era.

Ping’s Identity for AI solution is already in the market and gaining strong traction with global enterprises. Working across product, engineering, sales, and go-to-market teams, you’ll help deliver innovative capabilities that solve real customer challenges. You’ll partner with teams across Ping that move fast, listen closely, and obsess over user value. 

The Product Manager role is an important part of Ping Identity’s worldwide go to market strategy. Reporting to the Group Product Manager for Identity for AI, you’ll drive product execution by defining requirements, managing the roadmap and backlog, and turning strategy into customer value. You’ll serve as the voice of the customer for engineering while providing product expertise and use-case guidance to the field.

At Ping, we’re using AI to accelerate delivery, improve decision-making, and increase effectiveness across the product lifecycle - giving you the opportunity to help shape how AI transforms product management itself.

  • Provide detailed input into the product planning process and priority of features for communication to engineering.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness across product management workflows, including research, analysis, documentation, prioritization, and cross-functional communication.

  • Cloud computing experience  in a product management or engineering role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.


About the Product Team 

At Emplifi, our mission is to transform how digital marketing—especially on social—is done, and how consumers connect with brands in the 21st century.

Our Product team sits at the heart of this mission. We build and evolve a data-driven SaaS platform that helps global enterprises market smarter. By bridging customer needs, business goals, and technical innovation, we break down silos, foster collaboration, and use insights to guide smart, impactful decisions.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape the future of Emplifi’s Data Insights capabilities — a core product area that enables brands to understand conversations, uncover emerging topics, and act on market signals that matter most.

This is about building intelligence that helps brands understand what people care about, how perceptions evolve, and where opportunities arise across digital channels. You’ll be leading a product area that helps marketers and strategists collect the right data and turn them into actionable insight—at scale.

You’ll own the roadmap, vision, and execution for this strategic capability, partnering closely with design, engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to create powerful, intuitive experiences for enterprise users. This includes managing integrations with external data providers to ensure scalable, high-quality access to insights.

This position is remote/hybrid from within the Czech Republic, the UK, France, or Germany. 



Why This Role Matters

In today’s world, tracking discourse, sentiment, and context across digital sources gives brands a competitive edge. Organizations that move fast to uncover trends, surface risks, and respond to emergent feedback win. You’ll lead a product at the intersection of data, AI, and strategy helping the world’s leading brands stay in tune with conversations, perceptions, and signals that shape their markets.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about turning complex, unstructured data into clear insight and action
  • Understands how enterprise marketers, analysts, and strategists use insights to guide decisions
  • Can translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions powered by AI and analytics
  • Thrives in a space where technology, storytelling, and customer empathy meet

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the vision and roadmap for one of the Data Insights product line — setting direction based on customer needs, market dynamics, and company goals
  • Drive product discovery - talking to customers (brands and retailers), observing behavior, synthesizing data, and identifying unmet needs and opportunities
  • Translate ideas into execution - write clear requirements, work with design and engineering, and iterate fast to deliver impactful, high-quality solutions
  • Be a market expert - understand the competitive landscape and adjacent categories, monitor trends in ecommerce and AI, and translate them into product strategy
  • Manage data partnerships and integrations - oversee connections with third-party data providers and APIs, ensuring consistent, reliable data access, evaluate vendor performance, react quickly to API or data schema changes, and balance product impact against integration costs
  • Partner cross-functionally - collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership to position the product for success across the customer lifecycle

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do

Our Data Centre Design and Construction team is responsible for leading the expansion of CoreWeave's global footprint, managing the full lifecycle of mission-critical facility builds from pre-construction planning through commissioning and turnover. This team ensures our data centres are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence to support our high-performance cloud infrastructure.

As the Data Center Construction Project Manager, you will serve as the primary owner's representative, leading the overall direction, completion, and financial outcomes of multiple data centre construction projects. In this full-time on-site role, you will administer contracts with developers and general contractors, maintaining rigorous oversight of drawings, specifications, change management, and statutory planning approvals. Additionally, you will drive project schedules, manage multi-million pound budgets, and partner cross-functionally with supply chain, design, and executive stakeholders to ensure seamless project turnover.

Preferred:

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Motorway 
 Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.
 This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.
 The Opportunity 
 As a Lead Product Designer at Motorway, you won't just be producing great design - you'll be raising the ceiling for everyone around you. You'll shape how the team works, set the standard for craft and rigour, and bring a clear point of view on where design is heading.
 You'll take ownership of our most complex design challenges, working across the full product lifecycle from discovery to delivery. You'll be a trusted voice in cross-functional conversations, a mentor to other designers, and someone who actively shapes the culture and ways of working within the design team.
 This is a role for someone who thinks deeply, builds boldly, and leads by doing.

 This isn't a role for a pixel-pusher. We want a visionary with a builder’s soul. You will step into an environment where your work has immediate, massive scale, and your leadership directly influences the future of our product ecosystem.

 Designing Beyond the Screen: You'll bring a "builder mindset" to the table, collaborating seamlessly with engineering because you speak their language—whether that’s through code, complex prototypes, or building your own tools.

 Championing the User: You will be the fierce advocate for our users, leveraging deep research, continuous usability testing, and sharp data insights to validate every move we make.

 Driving Design Culture: Help foster a strong design culture by contributing to weekly team rituals, running workshops, planning design-focused events, and encouraging diverse participation. You love bringing people together around ideas.

 Continuous Improvement: Explore and encourage continuous learning across the team, playing an active role in developing our core design principles and keeping the team sharp on emerging tools, patterns, and practices.

 Versatile Experience: A strong grasp of consumer journeys, ideally with experience navigating both B2C and B2B product landscapes.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager- Time to First Production
jobs.description:
Register Here! 
 
 Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 
 
 About the role: 
 From the moment a team opens Camunda for the first time, our job is to help them succeed — fast. As Principal Product Manager for Time to First Production, you'll own exactly that experience: the journey from a new team's very first workspace (or first local start) to their first process running confidently in production. Your mission is simple to say and genuinely exciting to build: make that first win happen sooner, more smoothly, and more reliably than ever before.
 You'll be the DRI for one of Product Strategy's three company-wide outcome areas, with real license to shape it — define what a great first experience looks like, build the measurement that proves we're delivering it, and set the strategy and priorities that Engineering, Design, and our Experience org build against. It's a founding-type mandate: the outcome area is established and the ambition is clear, and you'll have the room to define the metric, the roadmap, and the experience that gets us there.
 You'll work at the intersection of Camunda's push into agentic, AI-first ways of building (AI-assisted modeling, agentic development, ProcessOS-style process re-engineering) and the fundamentals of a great first-run experience (onboarding, guided building, testing, and the path to production). It's a role for someone who loves turning a bold, company-wide ambition — delight customers from day one — into a measurable, funded, and genuinely exciting product
 Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Own the Time to First Production outcome area end to end: define its north-star metric(s), the customer journey they represent, and the roadmap of investments ("rocks" and initiatives) that move them.

 Partner with the Validation team to build best-in-class, end-to-end measurement of the journey, so we always know exactly how well we're delivering for new teams and where to invest next.

 Set direction and make prioritization calls across a portfolio of initiatives spanning AI-assisted and agentic building experiences, guided onboarding, testing/validation tooling, the path to production, and human-in-the-loop process experiences — in close partnership with Engineering, Design, and Experience pod leads.

 Represent this outcome area to SLT, Product Marketing, and GTM, translating fast-moving product work into a clear, evidence-based narrative for internal and external audiences.

 Collaborate closely with fellow Outcome DRIs (Enterprise Adoption, Production Confidence) to keep the three outcome areas coherent as one product strategy, and to hand work cleanly across the outcome boundaries (e.g., "first process" vs. "the second process and beyond").

 Bring an outside-in, evidence-based lens — grounding roadmap decisions in real customer needs and feedback, not internal assumptions.

 
 What You Bring: 
 Significant experience as a Principal/Staff-level Product Manager owning a cross-cutting, metrics-driven outcome or platform area (not a single feature surface) in B2B or enterprise SaaS.

 A track record of building measurement and north-star metrics from scratch — comfortable partnering with data/analytics functions to go from "we don't really know" to a credible, trusted number.

 Strong influence and cross-functional leadership skills: you can align Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive stakeholders around a strategy without relying on formal authority.

 Excellent written communication — this role's primary tool is the strategy document that others build against, so clear, structured writing matters as much as decision-making.

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.

What you’ll do:

  • Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.
  • Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.
  • Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals.
  • Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.
  • Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments.
  • Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics.
  • Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners.
  • Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality.

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
 Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
 Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
 Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
 Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
 Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 

 Dein Profil 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
 Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
 Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
 Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
 Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
 Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
 Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
 Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
 Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
 Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
 Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.
 Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und Ergebnisse liefern wollen.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.
 Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt.
 Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt.
 Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern.
 Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess.
 Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen.
 Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf.
 

 Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall.
 Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe.
 Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten.
 Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde.
 Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft.
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst.
 Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen.
 Große Stückzahlen, große Wirkung: Wir entwickeln bewusst wenige Modelle mit hohem Volumen. Technische Verbesserungen, die du entwickelst, wirken sich direkt auf hunderttausende Produkte aus.
 Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen.
 Du stellst dein eigenes Team zusammen: Du entscheidest mit, welche Kompetenzen wir wann intern aufbauen und entwickelst daraus eine leistungsstarke Footwear-Development-Organisation.
 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Design und Sourcing: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und keine langen Konzernschleifen zwischen Entwicklung, Design und Produktion.
 Nähe zu den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit den Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und kannst technische Produktentscheidungen direkt auf höchster Ebene beeinflussen.
 Internationales Produktionsumfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktions-, Material- und Tooling-Partnern in Asien zusammen und bist dort, wo die Produkte tatsächlich entstehen.
 Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt schneller Kompromisse: Bei Pammys ist Passform kein Detail. Du bekommst den Raum, Standards aufzubauen, mit denen unsere Produkte technisch und qualitativ langfristig besser werden.
 Wachstum mit Verantwortung: Mit neuen Modellen, Kategorien und höheren Volumen wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich und damit die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Produktfunktion bei Pammys langfristig zu prägen.

You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

 What you'll work on

 
 Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain 

 Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.

 Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

 
 Our humble expectations

 We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.

 
 You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.

 You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.

 You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.

 You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.

We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities.

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.
