jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Too Good To Go, we dream of a planet with no food waste.

Did you know that more than 40% of all food produced gets thrown away? This unnecessary food waste — and the resources needed to produce and transport it — accounts for 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.

Why This Role

Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.

We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.

You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.

The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.

There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.

Your Mission

As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.

In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need. From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.

Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.

Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.

You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.

The Team

You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.

This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.

The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us
 Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.
 
 The Role
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.
 This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.
 This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.
 
 What You’ll do
 Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.

 Talk to users directly . Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.

 Do your own data work . You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.

 Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan . Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.

 Design and run tests . Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.

 Drive product development from concept to launch . Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making

 Own the outcome, not the output . Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.

 Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about.

 
 What we’re looking for

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our  (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d) , you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our  Customer APIs , the  Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) , and, going forward, the  Unified Financial Platform (UFP)  as well as our  HubSpot integration . 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the  roadmap for our Customer APIs  across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the  migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next , identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our  Unified Carrier Interface (UCI)  in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our  Unified Financial Platform (UFP)  and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing  HubSpot integration  and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a  technical background , for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a  Product Owner or Product Manager , ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of  APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies  and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers. 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences. 

 You are confident in  stakeholder management  and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs. 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most. 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in  Hamburg and Naarden . 

 You are curious about  AI tools and digital solutions  and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows. 

 Experience in  logistics, parcel, or freight tech , particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with  HubSpot or CRM integrations , as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

 What will be your responsibility Own a set of product topics end to end, from the customer problem through to a shipped result that delivers real value
 Decide what is worth building and in what order for your topics, shape the concept, and drive it through delivery together with engineering
 Run discovery with customers to understand what they actually need, test your assumptions rather than building on guesses, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
 Own the flow of customer requests and insights: make sense of what customers are asking for, decide what it means for the product, route it to the right place, and turn a stream of raw input into clear product direction
 Translate real problems into clear, well-scoped, buildable definitions, working spec-driven (currently with OpenSpec) at a high bar
 Invent viable product concepts in a category with no existing product to copy
 Shape the UX and UI together with engineering, based on the existing product and the component library - we have no dedicated designer in the team
 Work hand in hand with our remote engineering team throughout the build rather than through handover: analyse a solution for gaps and edge cases before it is built, using AI where it helps, and after shipping, check whether the outcome delivered its intended value and works for users

analyse problems, since we're an AI-first team and expect the same of you.

jobs.title: Project Manager & Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (if you are not located in the Zurich area), the role will be based remotely from Germany or Austria or onsite in Zurich.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month — these visits are financially supported by BLP.

 Your Mission 
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.

 
 What We’re Really Looking For 
 The following key attributes ensure success in this role:
 Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth Mindset – You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Customer-First Mentality – You think beyond implementation — you care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

 
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills — you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

 
 Benefits 
 High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

 Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

 Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

 Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

 Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

 Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Product Owner – SDV Data Products (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: 
 Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. 

 Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. 

 
 
 Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: 
 Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. 

 Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. 

 No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. 

 Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. 

 Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. 

 

 About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. 

 Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. 

 Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. 

 Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. 

 Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. 

 Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. 

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. 

 A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. 

 A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. 

 A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. 

 

 What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. 

 Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. 

 Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. 

 Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. 

 Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. 

 Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery. 

 Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate. 

 Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health. 

 

 Nice to Have Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically. 

 Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work. 

 

 Our Software Stack SQL 

 Jira 

 Confluence 

 API Documentation tools 

 

 Why us? On top of a competitive package… 
 We are open to flexible work models: we work in a hybrid mode. 

 To encourage education and professional growth, we offer an individual yearly budget of €1,200. 

 You are entitled to 30 vacation days per year. 

 Public transport contribution. 

 We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut. 

 We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive. 

 

 Salary Range (Annual On-Target Earnings) 65,000 - 70,000

 VP Product interview (45 min)

jobs.title: Product Owner – Autonomous Lending
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank 
 Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
 Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
 
 Department Description 
 Allica Bank aims to provide Expert Banking for Business Britain by providing excellent customer experience and pioneering technology solutions to facilitate this. 
 The Autonomous Lending tribe runs across multiple business lines including Credit Operations and Underwriting, with a mission to build AI-first lending origination journeys, automating origination capabilities, data flows, and underwriting and operational workflow management. 
 The tribe is a critical driver for Allica to continue to realise its vision of providing a market leading relationship-based banking experience, at a speed and cost to serve the rest of the market cannot match. 

 Role Description 
The Product Owner will lead the work to define, deliver and manage AI-enabled products across our lending journeys, bringing together product design and thinking with a strong working knowledge of what today’s AI can and cannot do. 
 You will be accountable for the roadmap of your team and for the full product lifecycle: discovery and design, day-to-day delivery, launch and adoption by colleagues and customers, and how risks are addressed once a product is live. You will aim to build robust, automated and well-governed systems and processes that enable us to move quickly and innovate our lending and financing products in the SME banking market. 
 Whilst a lot of the market aims to avoid the complex nature of SME businesses, we are going for it head on, designing simple and efficient solutions to the most complex problems in the market to provide excellent and efficient customer experience. We aim for our external view of the lending product, as well as our internal systems to be the best in market which will allow us to scale quickly to serve more UK SMEs, while doing so in a cost-effective manner.

 Principal Accountabilities 
 Responsible for innovation and building end-to-end solutions for AI-enabled lending product, origination, underwriting and operational flows

 Lead a small cross-functional team (e.g. a full stack engineer and AI specialist) to deliver your roadmap

 Continuously review business needs, refine priorities and iterate towards measurable outcomes – judged on fewer requests for further information, more applications decided with AI, less colleague time per application across underwriting and credit operations, and risk outcomes no worse than the equivalent manual journey

 Prototype and experiment quickly – vibe-code working prototypes yourself, close enough to the real thing that an engineer can harden it into production code

 Determine the accuracy of AI solutions by analysing the data yourself and building the verified “ground truth” datasets that results are tested against, working with underwriters and credit operations colleagues to agree what a correct answer looks like

 Take responsibility for launch and adoption – briefing stakeholders, training the teams who will use the product, and closing the loop on the feedback they give back

 Produce the written work that keeps delivery moving and safe – clear descriptions of what we are building and why, a record of the important design decisions and trade-offs made, and the assessments needed to get a product approved and live, covering risk, security, cost, data and legal considerations, and taking the change through the bank’s governance and approval process

 Line manage, coach and develop your team, setting a high bar for delivery and for the responsible use of AI

 
 Personal Attributes & Experience 
 Knowledge of commercial lending origination and underwriting processes, principles and systems

 Experience in a fast-moving or high-growth business

 Proven track record of delivering agentic and data-driven products into live use

 Strong process design, implementation and automation skills

 Hands-on familiarity with Python, SQL and data analytics tools, alongside LLM tooling, prompt engineering and AI orchestration – you do not need to be an engineer or an analyst, but you should be able to build something that works, query the data yourself, and understand and sense-check what AI is producing

 Understanding of privacy and safety considerations when applying LLMs in production, and of how to prove and monitor accuracy once a solution is live – ideally in a regulated environment

 Strong analytical skills and business acumen, comfortable digging into data yourself to size a problem, measure performance and assemble the reference datasets accuracy is judged against

 Metric and outcome driven approach – setting th

jobs.title: Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
jobs.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

 Location: Manchester

 Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

 Package: £80k OTE 

 

 As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

 You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

 Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

 Key Objectives 

 Core Accountability 

 
 Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.

 Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.

 Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.

 Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.

 Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 
 

 Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

 
 Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.

 Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.

 Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.

 Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 
 

 

 Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

 
 Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.

 Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.

 Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.

 Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 
 

 Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

 
 Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.

 Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.

 Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.

 Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 
 

 Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

 
 Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.

 Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.

 Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.

 Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 
 

 Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

 
 Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.

 Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.

 Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.

 Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 
 

 

 About PHMG: 

 Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the glob

 Job Description Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders? 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

 What you will be do: 
 Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
 Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
 Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
 Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
 Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
 Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
 Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
 Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
 Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
 Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.

 Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability
jobs.description:
About A1 
 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.
 Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.
  
 Role
 This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application. 
  
 What You'll be Doing 
 Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

 Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

 Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

 Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

 Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

 Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization

 Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops

 Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

  
 What You Will Need 
 Technical foundation
 Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

 Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.

 Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

 AI & ML experience
 Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

 Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

 Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

 Product leadership
 Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

 Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

 Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

  
 Nice to have
 Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

 Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

 Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

 Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

 Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

  
 Outcomes 
 Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

 AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

 Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

 Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

 Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

  
 How We Work 
 The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. 
 Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product.
  
 Interview process 
 If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.
 Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.
 We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Product Manager E-Commerce (m/w/d) - rechte Hand der Geschäftsführung
jobs.description:
Clevertronic ist der Rundum-Partner fürs Smartphone-Leben: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Smartphones, Tablets und weitere Elektronik an, bereiten sie professionell auf und geben ihnen als geprüfte Refurbished-Produkte ein zweites Leben.

 Mit rund 100 Kolleg:innen, mehr als 50 Mio. Euro Umsatz und profitablem Wachstum ohne Investoren gehören wir zu den größten Refurbishing-Unternehmen Deutschlands. Jetzt entwickeln wir Clevertronic zu einer Plattform rund ums Smartphone-Leben weiter - mit neuen Produkten, Geschäftsmodellen und Märkten.

 Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die direkt mit unserer Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeitet, eigene Themen vorantreibt und aus Ideen messbare Ergebnisse macht.

 Aufgaben

 
 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für E-Commerce-Produkte und strategische Projekte: von der ersten Analyse bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.

 Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du neue Produkte, Geschäftsfelder und Wachstumsinitiativen.

 Du steuerst deine Themen anhand messbarer Ergebnisse wie Umsatz, Conversion und Kundenzufriedenheit.

 Du begleitest Projekte nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern packst auch im Tagesgeschäft mit an und lernst unsere Prozesse von Grund auf kennen.

 Du setzt KI gezielt ein, um Analysen, Prozesse und die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen schneller und besser zu machen.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du bringst relevante Praxiserfahrung im E-Commerce mit und verstehst die Mechanismen von Onlineshops und digitalen Customer Journeys.

 Du hast bereits ein Produkt, Projekt, Geschäftsfeld oder eigenes Business von Grund auf aufgebaut und erfolgreich vorangetrieben.

 Du kannst unterschiedliche Fachbereiche zusammenbringen und aus einer Idee einen umsetzbaren Plan entwickeln.

 Du interessierst dich für KI und nutzt sie bereits als praktisches Werkzeug in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

 Du hast Lust, dich intensiv mit unseren operativen Prozessen auseinanderzusetzen und auch bei den Details mit anzupacken.

 Du hast große Ambitionen und willst in den nächsten Jahren außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung übernehmen - zunächst für eigene Projekte, perspektivisch für ein eigenes Team und einen eigenen Geschäftsbereich.

 
 Benefits

 
 Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung: Du sitzt bei Strategie, Zahlen und Entscheidungen mit am Tisch - mit eigener Stimme, nicht als Zuhörer. Was du dabei über die Führung eines Unternehmens dieser Größe mitnimmst, ist der Nebeneffekt.

 Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurze Wege: zwischen deiner Idee und der Entscheidung liegt bei uns ein Gespräch, kein Lenkungsausschuss.

 Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht ausbremst, sondern fördert: bei uns ist KI-gestütztes Arbeiten der Standard, nicht die Ausnahme.

 Außergewöhnliche Entwicklungsperspektive: du startest mit eigenen Projekten, kannst bei starken Ergebnissen ein eigenes Team aufbauen und perspektivisch einen eigenen Geschäftsbereich verantworten.

 
 Für einen guten Arbeitsalltag ist ebenfalls gesorgt: flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein modernes Büro direkt am Friedenspark in Münster, subventioniertes Lunch, Snack-Kiosk, Kaffee und frisches Obst, Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte und Corporate Benefits.

 Du möchtest nicht nur verwalten, sondern gestalten und unternehmerische Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

 Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz diese drei Fragen:

 
 Was hast du zuletzt eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg gebracht?

 Was würdest du an unserem Shop als Erstes verändern?

 Was willst du in 5 Jahren verantworten - und warum ist Clevertronic der schnellere Weg dorthin als dein aktueller Job?

 
 Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

jobs.title: Product Manager - Quest Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU 

 

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own and develop the Quest Platform — a major company initiative that consolidates all quest-related functionality in one place and integrates it across all Xsolla products. This includes quests within products such as Web Shop, Xsolla Player, and Cloud Gaming. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and cross-product teams to create engaging quest experiences, drive user engagement, and ensure seamless integration across all Xsolla products.

 

 

 ABOUT US 

 

 Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

 

 For more information, visit xsolla.com .

 Responsibilities: 

 Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for the Quest Platform

 Create and manage new quests within the platform, acting as its primary advocate

 Oversee quest UI implementation 

 Define and track key product metrics (engagement, completion rates, retention impact)

 Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements

 Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure smooth integration with Web Shop, Xsolla Player, Cloud Gaming, and future products

 Continuously optimize quest experiences based on data and user feedback

 Qualifications & Skills: 

 Experience as a Product Manager working on engagement, gamification, or loyalty products

 Strong understanding of gaming ecosystems (mobile, PC, console)

 Ability to work with cross-functional teams and manage complex dependencies

 Data-driven mindset with experience defining and tracking product KPIs

 

 Nice to Have: 

 Engineering background

 Background in mobile gaming or game studios

 Experience with loyalty programs, gamification, or rewards systems

 Experience building platform products that integrate across multiple services

 Benefits 

 

 We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes unlimited Flexible Time Off, Gym membership, monthly train ticket and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

 

 The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization’s goals and individual growth. This job description is intended to outline the general nature and level of work being performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required.

 

 By submitting your application, you consent to Xsolla conducting background checks, where permitted by law, after the final interview stage. All checks will comply with local regulations, and your information will be handled confidentially.

 

 Xsolla takes your privacy seriously and will not sell or externally distribute any personal data received during the hiring process. In accordance with applicable data protection laws, Xsolla is committed to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy.
